title: 第二十五章黑暗中的杀机第二十六章杀人无声暗夜惊变
slug: 玄幻乱世猎户从箭术到人间武圣
content_zh:
今天天气不错。
夜晚的风很大，白沙镇的夜空暂时还是没看到什么乌云，缺了角的月亮悬挂在空中。
镇子北边数里，大青山下方，废弃山神庙，人声嘈杂，火把攒动，宛若白昼。
王麻子带着归有德等人站在人群边缘。
和义堂的正式弟子不多，真正拜了香堂登记名册的只有几十人，在大齐帝国，鄙视链无所不在，若是没能锤炼出气血，不是练家子，连加入社团的资格都没有。
在这些人中，真正的核心只有七八个人。
他们全都是一次淬体圆满的真正武者，堂主苏大鹏是差一点就能二次淬体大圆满的武者。
对面的四海帮差不多也是如此，双方实力相当。
这里有一个冷知识，和义堂的核心大多在白云武馆修炼过，四海帮的核心多来自长河武馆。
像王麻子这样没有经过武馆修炼，通过修炼市面上买来的不入品的功法锤炼十几缕气血的家伙，别说实力孱弱，就算是一次淬体圆满也难以成为核心。
一句话，不是自己人！
所以，王麻子带着归有德等人站在外围。
山神庙外面有个小广场，和义堂和四海帮的人各自占据南北，中间有着一条一丈宽的通道。
双方各自有一两百人，人数差不多。
大部分都是外围弟子，像归有德这样临时花钱拉来的家伙，没有练过功法的普通人。
和义堂这边的组成，以镇上的浪荡子居多。
四海帮那边则是码头苦力、打鱼的渔夫为主。
小广场的人虽然很多，实际上，不过是摇旗呐喊以壮声势为主，会不会打起来取决于山神庙内的两边核心的谈判。
“麻子哥，会不会打起来？”
归有德站在王麻子身侧，双股战战，面色苍白，小声地说道，在说话的时候还扭头望了一眼身后的林子。

他没有参加过如此规模的晒马，难免担心。
“怎么，害怕？”
“这个场面你都害怕，以后怎么跟着我吃大茶饭？”
“兄弟，干我们这一行，没胆可不行，你听过没，狼行千里吃肉，狗走千里还是吃屎……”
王麻子瞧了归有德一眼，冷笑一声。
“不怕啊！”
“只是，这不是第一次见识大场面么？须得哥哥指点一二，免得犯错……”
归有德谄笑着说道。
“哈哈……”
王麻子满意地轻笑两声。
当老大带小弟，除了剥削小弟之外，乐趣还在于小弟可以随时给自己提供情绪价值。
“放心，打不起来的！”
“就算两边谈崩，今晚也不会打起来！”
王麻子摆了摆手，一副智多星的模样。
“为什么呢？”
归有德问道，表情蠢萌。
“若是那么多人打起来，必定会有死伤，一旦有死伤，汤药费、抚恤费这些要不要给？”
content_en:
The weather is nice today.
The wind was very strong at night, and there were still no dark clouds in the night sky of Baisha Town. The moon with a missing corner hung in the sky.
A few miles north of the town, at the foot of Daqing Mountain, there is an abandoned mountain temple, with people noisy and torches flickering, just like daytime.
Wang Mazi, Gui Youde and others stood at the edge of the crowd.
There are not many formal disciples of Heyi Hall, and there are only a few dozen people who have actually worshiped and registered in Xiangtang. In the Daqi Empire, chains of contempt are everywhere. If you fail to temper your Qi and blood, you are not a Lianjiazi, and you are not even qualified to join the society.
Among these people, there are only seven or eight people who are the real core.
They are all true warriors who have perfected the body tempering once. The hall leader Su Dapeng is a warrior who is almost able to perfect the body tempering twice.
The same is almost true for the Sihai Gang on the opposite side, both sides are equally powerful.
Here is a little trivia: Most of the core members of He Yi Tang have trained at Baiyun Martial Arts School, and most of the core members of the Sihai Gang have come from Changhe Martial Arts School.
A guy like Wang Mazi who has not been trained in a martial arts school and has tempered more than a dozen strands of Qi and blood by practicing inferior techniques bought on the market, let alone weak in strength, will hardly be able to become the core even if he completes the body tempering once.
In a word, they are not one of our own!
Therefore, Wang Mazi, Gui Youde and others stood on the outside.
There is a small square outside the mountain temple. People from Heyi Tang and Sihai Gang occupy the north and south respectively. There is a one-foot-wide passage in the middle.
There were one or two hundred people on each side, about the same number.
Most of them are peripheral disciples, guys like Gui Youde who were brought in with temporary money, ordinary people who have never practiced any martial arts.
The He Yi Tang side is composed mostly of libertines from the town.
The Sihai Gang's side is dominated by wharf coolies and fishermen.
Although there are many people in the small square, in fact, they are just waving flags and shouting to build momentum. Whether there will be a fight depends on the negotiations between the two cores in the mountain temple.
"Brother Mazi, will there be a fight?"
Gui Youde stood beside Wang Mazi, his legs trembling, his face pale, and he whispered, turning his head to look at the forest behind him while speaking.
He has never participated in a horse show of this scale, so he is inevitably worried.
"What, scared?"
"You are afraid of this scene. How can you follow me to have a big meal in the future?"
"Brother, in our line of work, you can't do it without courage. Have you ever heard that a wolf travels a thousand miles to eat meat, and a dog travels a thousand miles to still eat shit..."
Wang Mazi glanced at Gui Youde and sneered.
"Don't be afraid!"
"It's just, isn't this the first time I've seen a big scene? I need some advice from my brother to avoid making mistakes..."
Gui Youde said with a flattering smile.
"Haha..."
Wang Mazi chuckled twice with satisfaction.
When the boss takes care of the younger brother, in addition to exploiting the younger brother, the fun is that the younger brother can provide emotional value to himself at any time.
"Don't worry, you can't fight!"
"Even if the two sides fail to talk, there will be no fight tonight!"
Wang Mazi waved his hand, looking very wise.
"Why?"
Gui Youde asked with a silly expression.
"If so many people fight, there will definitely be casualties. If there are casualties, do we need to pay for soup, medicine, and pensions?"
